defaultIsolationEvidence.source: Target-CI distributable lanes run inside a Linux network namespace with only loopback enabled, so the kernel denies cross-VM IP egress independently of the Node, native, or shell API used. Each file still runs in a fresh process, one file at a time. The preload guard adds before-I/O diagnostics for its recognized Node and child-process surfaces, including non-loopback Bash /dev/tcp and /dev/udp redirections; exact temporary executable fixtures remain explicitly declared.
